items.en: Written in easy English, this book is suitable for beginners.
items.fr: Écrit dans un anglais facile, ce livre est convenable aux débutants.
items.after: in easy English, this book is suitable for beginners.

items.en: Having thought about it, he decided not to go.
items.fr: Après y avoir réfléchi, il décida de ne pas y aller.
items.after: about it, he decided not to go.

items.en: Seen from a distance, the hill looks like an elephant.
items.fr: Vu de loin, la colline ressemble à un éléphant.
items.after: from a distance, the hill looks like an elephant.

items.en: Having done his work, he went out.
items.fr: Ayant fait son travail, il sortit.

items.en: Frustrated by the ticket, the driver furiously kicked the parking meter.
items.fr: Frustré par la contravention, le conducteur donna furieusement un coup de pied au parcmètre.
items.after: by the ticket, the driver furiously kicked the parking meter.

items.en: Having said that, he simply disappeared.
items.fr: Ayant dit cela, il disparut simplement.

items.en: Fanned by a strong wind, the fire spread in an instant.
items.fr: Attisé par un vent fort, le feu s'est répandu en un instant.
items.after: by a strong wind, the fire spread in an instant.

items.en: Having seen him before, I recognized him.
items.fr: L'ayant vu auparavant, je l'ai reconnu.

items.en: Lost in his thoughts, he seems to have forgotten what he just said.
items.fr: Plongé dans ses réflexions, il semblait avoir oublié ce qu’il venait de dire.
items.after: in his thoughts, he seems to have forgotten what he just said.

items.en: Having fed the dog, he sat down to his own dinner.
items.fr: Ayant nourri le chien, il a commencé son propre dîner.
items.after: the dog, he sat down to his own dinner.

items.en: Seen at a distance, the rock looks like a human face.
items.fr: Si on le regarde à distance, ce rocher ressemble à un visage humain.
items.after: at a distance, the rock looks like a human face.

items.en: Having failed many times, he never gave up the plan.
items.fr: Ayant échoué à de nombreuses reprises, il n'abandonna pourtant jamais le plan.
items.after: many times, he never gave up the plan.

items.en: Seen from a distance, the big rock looks like an old castle.
items.fr: Vu de loin ce grand rocher ressemble à un vieux château.
items.after: from a distance, the big rock looks like an old castle.

items.en: Having done my homework, I could finally watch television.
items.fr: Une fois mes devoirs terminés, j'ai enfin pu regarder la télévision.
items.after: my homework, I could finally watch television.

items.en: Having made up, following a long quarrel, Tom and Mary found themselves in the middle of this sentence.
items.fr: S'étant réconciliés après une longue brouille, Tom et Mary se retrouvèrent au milieu de cette phrase.
items.after: up, following a long quarrel, Tom and Mary found themselves in the middle of this sentence.
